records.Title: Image Quality
ExplainDesc: Select a preset or customize the graphics settings.

records.Title: Display Mode
ExplainDesc: Select the display mode for the game screen.

records.Title: Resolution
ExplainDesc: Select the game’s display resolution. A higher resolution produces a sharper image, but may affect performance.

records.Title: Resolution
ExplainDesc: Select the game’s display resolution. A higher resolution produces a sharper image, but may negatively affect performance.

records.Title: Select Display
ExplainDesc: Select the monitor used to display the game.

records.Title: 帧率限制
ExplainDesc: Select the maximum frame rate for the game.

records.Title: Shadow Quality
ExplainDesc: Adjust the level of detail for in-game shadows. The higher the setting, the finer the detail, but performance may be affected.

records.Title: Post-Processing Effects
ExplainDesc: Adjust the quality of the various post-processing effects. The higher the setting, the richer the visuals, but performance may be affected.

records.Title: Vertical Sync
ExplainDesc: Syncs the game’s frame rate with the monitor’s refresh rate to prevent screen tearing, but increases input lag.

records.Title: Ray Tracing
ExplainDesc: Enables ray tracing for more realistic, natural lighting and reflections.

records.Title: Screen Reflections
ExplainDesc: Enables screen space reflections, so reflective surfaces such as water and wet surfaces feature real-time reflections of the surrounding environment.

records.Title: Visual Detail
ExplainDesc: Controls the complexity and render distance of environmental models. The higher the setting, the farther complex environmental models render, but performance may be affected.

records.Title: Visual Quality
ExplainDesc: Controls the level of detail for static objects in the game world. The higher the setting, the more detailed the static objects, but performance may be affected.

records.Title: Character Quality
ExplainDesc: Controls the detail and dynamic effects of character models. The higher the setting, the finer the character models and dynamic effects, but performance may be affected.

records.Title: Effect Quality
ExplainDesc: Controls the number and level of physics simulation for dynamic particle effects. The higher the setting, the richer and more realistic the particle effects, but performance may be affected.

records.Title: Texture Detail
ExplainDesc: Controls the sharpness and realism of surface textures. The higher the setting, the sharper and more realistic the textures, but performance may be affected.

records.Title: Character Density
ExplainDesc: Controls the number of characters that can appear on screen at once. The higher the setting, the more characters which can appear on screen at once, but performance may be affected.

records.Title: Vehicle Density
ExplainDesc: Controls the number of vehicles that can appear on screen at once. The higher the setting, the more vehicles which can appear on screen at once, but performance may be affected.

records.Title: Volume
ExplainDesc: Adjust the game’s overall volume.

records.Title: Music Volume
ExplainDesc: Adjust music volume.

records.Title: Sound Effects Volume
ExplainDesc: Adjust sound effects volume.

records.Title: Voice Volume

records.Title: Pacifist Mode (Online)

records.Title: Auto Power-Saving Mode
ExplainDesc: Toggle auto power-saving mode. This mode automatically lowers the frame rate and brightness after long periods of inactivity to save power.

records.Title: Helicopter Control Assist
ExplainDesc: Toggle helicopter control assist. When enabled, the helicopter automatically maintains altitude, so its elevation will not drop while diving, pitching up, or banking.

records.Title: Assisted Combat Mode
ExplainDesc:
Toggle assisted combat mode. When enabled, you automatically receive the following help in combat:

Auto-Counter: For all attacks except red-aura attacks, your existing inputs are automatically upgraded to perfect counters.

Auto-Combo: Chain light or heavy strikes to perform smooth combos.

Danger Warning Slow-Mo: Time slows down briefly before an enemy’s red-aura attack lands, giving you ample time to react.

records.Title: 车辆转向辅助
ExplainDesc: 选择是否开启车辆转向辅助功能。开启后车辆转弯时会自动减速以获得更强的转向性能。

records.Title: Microphone mode
records.SubTitle: Push‑to‑talk / quick mic toggle
ExplainDesc:
Select the microphone mode.

Always On: The microphone stays on at all times.

Hold to Toggle Mic: Microphone is active only while you hold the mic button.

Tap to Toggle Mic: Tap the mic button to turn microphone on or off.

records.Title: Name Readout Feature
ExplainDesc: Toggle name readout feature. When enabled, characters in the game will address you by your chosen name in voiced dialogue.

records.Title: Aim Gyroscope
ExplainDesc: Toggle gyro aiming

records.Title: Aim Sensitivity of Gyroscope
ExplainDesc: Adjust gyro aiming sensitivity.

records.Title: High-Speed Driving Camera
ExplainDesc: Choose whether to apply the high-speed driving camera when driving at high speed.

records.Title: Show High VRAM Usage Popup
ExplainDesc: Choose whether to show the high VRAM usage popup. When enabled, a popup will appear on the main screen whenever VRAM usage is too high.

records.Title: Stick Position
ExplainDesc:
Select the position of the stick.

Dynamic Stick: The stick activates and is centered wherever you press with your finger.

Fixed Position: The stick stays in a fixed position on screen.

records.Title: 各向异性采样
ExplainDesc: 优化倾斜视角下的纹理采样精度。设置越高，斜向与远处的纹理越清晰，模糊感越少，但可能会影响性能。

records.Title: 云层质量
ExplainDesc: 控制天空中云朵的体积渲染精度与动态细节。设置越高，云朵的形状与层次感越真实自然，但可能会影响性能。

records.Title: 全局光照

records.Title: 夜间模式
ExplainDesc: 选择是否开启音频夜间模式。开启后会减少音频动态，这样即使在微弱的音量下也能听清大部分内容。反之，关闭时，音频动态较大，可提供更加影院级的音频效果。

records.Title: 音频效果预设
ExplainDesc: 选择音频的输出设备，会根据不同的输出设备类型切换不同的混音预设，以提供最好的音频体验。

records.Title: 镜头眩光
ExplainDesc: 选择是否开启镜头眩光。开启后模拟强光源在镜头内部产生的光斑与光晕，为画面增添电影质感与情绪氛围。
